QuestInfo.name: Request from a Doctor
QuestInfo.0: Raise your Level by helping the townspeople, like the Headmaster suggested.  #b#p2152004#, the Doctor#k, seems to need some help. Go see what she needs.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2152004#, a skilled doctor, says that the fruits from the trees in town can be used to make a simple medicine. She asks you to gather #b#t2022712##k items for her. 

#i4034738# #t4034738# #b#c4034738#/2#k
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the fruits and delivered them to #p2152004#. #p2152004# said that the town won't run out of medicine for a little while now. She added that preventing the townspeople from getting hurt in the first place was even more important than preparing medicine.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. Is something wrong? Do you need me to take a look? Hm? The Headmaster sent you to help people. So you've reached that age already, hm?
0.1: Well, perfect timing. I could use an assistant. Please gather some #t2022712#s from the fruit trees around town. They don't taste like much, but they make quite effective medicine.

yes.0: Thank you. When you hit the #rFruit Trees using regular attacks,#k they drop #t4034738#s. Please fetch me #b2#k of them.
yes.1: Fruit Trees look like this.\r\n#i3800090# \r\nYou'll find them all around the town and in the park.

no.0: The city's medical supplies are running low because of them... Would you reconsider? Our city needs help.

1.0:
Thank you. All of the city's medical supplies were confiscated, so I was running low. What are we going to do when we run out of #t2022712#s? Oh no... Anyway, what is the most important thing citizens of Edelstein can do to stay healthy? 
#L0##bMaintain a healthy diet and exercise regularly.#l
#L1#Take lots and lots of meds.#l
#L2#Surround themselves in an environment that minimizes their chance of illness and injury.#l
#k
1.1: Correct! Above all else, it's important to live in an environment that can prevent or minimize injury and illness. But Edelstein is far from that ideal right now. We never know who'll get hurt because of the blasted-- Eh, nevermind.

yes.0: How about paying #b#p2152002##k the #bStreetsweeper#k a visit next? He's always swamped with work.

0.0: Of course that's important! But don't you think something else is even MORE important? Think about it.
0.1: Well, medicine helps when you're already sick, but shouldn't you try to keep yourself from getting sick in the first place?

item.0: You haven't found #b2 #t4034738# items#k yet? You can find fruit trees everywhere. Just use a #rregular attack on fruit trees#k and #t4034738# items will fall from them.
